summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Arizona Sonoran Copper Company via court-approved plan of arrangement. Hudbay acquired all outstanding Arizona Sonoran shares; former shareholders received 0.242 Hudbay shares per Arizona Sonoran share (implied stock consideration). The deal creates the third largest copper district in North America, combining Copper World and Cactus projects. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee was explicitly stated. The transaction closed effective June 24, 2026. Watch for integration execution and U.S. copper production ramp-up, with risk-arb focus on any post-closing shareholder disputes.
